title: Cross-Domain Golden Proof
objective: Resolve one bounded cross-domain golden proof over completed KFR-01 through KFR-07 semantics, visibility, provenance, owner authority and deterministic behavior without introducing new KFR truth, canonical mutation or unauthorized successor scope.

resolved_contract.golden_scenario: Compose one deterministic navigator/mechanic knowledge scenario across KFR-01 vocabulary/crosswalk, KFR-02 graph, KFR-03 character records, KFR-04 advisory transfer, KFR-05 vehicle/machine qualification, KFR-06 profession/research/mentorship/learning owner evidence and KFR-07 visibility-safe search/inspection/provenance UX.
resolved_contract.fixture_rule: The visible fixture contains explicit MIB-14 vehicle/machine, DPL profession, DPL-03 research and Character familiarity references plus deliberately unauthorized hidden counterparts. KFR-08 may compose existing completed projections only; it does not redefine their semantics.
resolved_contract.visibility_rule: Unauthorized subjects, nodes, edges, records, transfer rules, qualification evidence, owner evidence/advisory context and UX entries are filtered by their owning KFR projections before any KFR-08 aggregate, provenance chain, count, search/inspection, receipt or AI-context output. Hidden cardinality remains undisclosed.
resolved_contract.unknown_conflict_rule: Explicit-unknown KFR-03 evidence remains unknown through KFR-04 advisory transfer; conflicting visible KFR-05 qualified/unqualified owner evidence resolves to unknown with canonical-owner conflict; conflicting KFR-06 research confirmed/not-confirmed evidence remains unknown while explicit-unknown mentorship remains unknown.
resolved_contract.owner_authority_rule: MIB-14/D17 vehicle/equipment, Character, DPL profession, DPL-03 research, DPL-09 mentorship/training, Progression/Skill, AuthoringAuthority and Permission/visibility owners remain authoritative. The golden proof grants no permission, action authority, ownership/custody, proficiency/certification, profession advancement, research truth resolution, mentorship enrollment or canonical write.
resolved_contract.provenance_rule: The proof may aggregate only explicit provenance references already emitted by completed KFR projections. Missing provenance remains missing and no provenance reference may be fabricated or inferred.
resolved_contract.authoring_rule: KFR-07 authoring intent remains intent/proposal UX only. The golden fixture deliberately uses a non-matching authority dimension so authoring intent is denied and no authority inheritance, draft/proposal mutation, publication, reveal or canonical promotion occurs.
resolved_contract.determinism_rule: KFR-08 produces one stable cross-domain receipt derived from completed KFR deterministic receipts and stable visible summary fields; reversing fixture input order must not change the receipt.
resolved_contract.production_scope: A thin cross-domain proof composer plus accessible nonvisual proof panel is authorized solely to compose completed KFR-01..07 projections and expose proof assertions. No new familiarity, graph, transfer, qualification, owner-evidence, search, authoring or canonical-write algorithm is authorized.
resolved_contract.persistence_decision: No durable KFR-08 persistence, duplicate graph/index/provenance ledger or write store; migration 0022 remains unreserved.
resolved_contract.validation: Exactly one current KFR-08 Validation Core profile with zero historical predecessor fanout; genuine RED before production; final exact-head self-hosted Linux/Windows and deterministic comparison.

preserved_boundaries: KFR-01 through KFR-07 remain completed_verified with implementation authority retired.
Canonical KFR owners, source-domain owners, AuthoringAuthority and Permission/visibility systems remain authoritative.
No new KFR semantic algorithm, canonical write, permission escalation, provenance fabrication, hidden-data reveal, durable persistence or migration 0022 is authorized.
ODL-01+, provider activation, tester distribution, release and deployment remain unauthorized.
